question:
A factory produces two models of microcomputers, A and B. Each model requires two identical processes. The processing time, sales profit, and maximum processing capacity of the factory per week for each microcomputer model are shown in Table 3.1.

Table 3.1

| Process | Model | Maximum Processing Capacity |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
|  | A | B |  |
| Process I (hours per unit) | 4 | 6 | 150 |
| Process II (hours per unit) | 3 | 2 | 70 |
| Profit (RMB per unit) | 300 | 450 |  |

If the factory's desired objectives and priority levels are as follows:

$p_{1}$: Total profit per week should not be less than 10,000 RMB;

$p_{2}$: Due to contractual requirements, at least 10 units of model A and 15 units of model B must be produced per week;

$p_{3}$: The weekly production time for Process I should be exactly 150 hours, and the production time for Process II should be maximized, even if overtime is necessary.

Establish the goal programming model for this problem.

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "products": ["A", "B"],
    "processes": ["I", "II"],
    # hours per unit: process_time[process][product]
    "process_time": {
        "I": {"A": 4, "B": 6},
        "II": {"A": 3, "B": 2},
    },
    "capacity": {"I": 150, "II": 70},
    "profit": {"A": 300, "B": 450},
    # goal targets
    "profit_target": 10000,
    "min_units": {"A": 10, "B": 15},
    "process_I_target": 150,
    "process_II_target": 70,
    # priority weights (lexicographic dominance)
    "weight_p1": 1000000,
    "weight_p2": 1000,
    "weight_p3": 1,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets ---
    model.PRODUCTS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.PROCESSES = pyo.Set(initialize=d["processes"])
    # deviation index sets
    model.P1_GOALS = pyo.Set(initialize=["profit"])
    model.P2_GOALS = pyo.Set(initialize=["A", "B"])
    model.P3_GOALS = pyo.Set(initialize=["I", "II"])

    # --- Variables ---
    # production quantities (integer units)
    model.prod = pyo.Var(model.PRODUCTS, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # deviations for p1 (profit goal)
    model.dev_minus_p1 = pyo.Var(model.P1_GOALS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.dev_plus_p1 = pyo.Var(model.P1_GOALS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # deviations for p2 (contract minimums)
    model.dev_minus_p2 = pyo.Var(model.P2_GOALS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.dev_plus_p2 = pyo.Var(model.P2_GOALS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # deviations for p3 (process goals)
    model.dev_minus_p3 = pyo.Var(model.P3_GOALS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.dev_plus_p3 = pyo.Var(model.P3_GOALS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # --- Constraints ---
    # p1: total profit >= 10000
    def profit_goal_rule(m):
        return (
            sum(d["profit"][p] * m.prod[p] for p in m.PRODUCTS)
            + m.dev_minus_p1["profit"]
            - m.dev_plus_p1["profit"]
            == d["profit_target"]
        )
    model.profit_goal = pyo.Constraint(rule=profit_goal_rule)

    # p2: at least min units of each model
    def contract_rule(m, p):
        return (
            m.prod[p] + m.dev_minus_p2[p] - m.dev_plus_p2[p]
            == d["min_units"][p]
        )
    model.contract = pyo.Constraint(model.P2_GOALS, rule=contract_rule)

    # p3: Process I time exactly 150
    def process_I_rule(m):
        return (
            sum(d["process_time"]["I"][p] * m.prod[p] for p in m.PRODUCTS)
            + m.dev_minus_p3["I"]
            - m.dev_plus_p3["I"]
            == d["process_I_target"]
        )
    model.process_I_goal = pyo.Constraint(rule=process_I_rule)

    # p3: Process II time target (maximize usage)
    def process_II_rule(m):
        return (
            sum(d["process_time"]["II"][p] * m.prod[p] for p in m.PRODUCTS)
            + m.dev_minus_p3["II"]
            - m.dev_plus_p3["II"]
            == d["process_II_target"]
        )
    model.process_II_goal = pyo.Constraint(rule=process_II_rule)

    # --- Objective ---
    # Minimize weighted deviations honouring priorities.
    def obj_rule(m):
        p1_cost = d["weight_p1"] * sum(
            m.dev_minus_p1[k] for k in m.P1_GOALS
        )
        p2_cost = d["weight_p2"] * sum(
            m.dev_minus_p2[k] for k in m.P2_GOALS
        )
        # p3: Process I exact (both deviations), Process II maximize (minus only)
        p3_cost = d["weight_p3"] * (
            m.dev_minus_p3["I"]
            + m.dev_plus_p3["I"]
            + m.dev_minus_p3["II"]
        )
        return p1_cost + p2_cost + p3_cost
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# =============================================================================
# GOAL PROGRAMMING MODEL FOR MICROCOMPUTER PRODUCTION (models A and B)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   xA : units of model A produced per week   (NonNegativeIntegers)
#   xB : units of model B produced per week   (NonNegativeIntegers)
#
# Deviation variables (goal programming, all NonNegativeReals):
#   d1_minus : under-achievement of the profit goal (P1)
#   d2A_minus: under-achievement of the minimum-A contract goal (P2)
#   d2B_minus: under-achievement of the minimum-B contract goal (P2)
#   d3I_minus: under-use of Process I below 150 h (P3, exact-use goal)
#   d3I_plus : over-use of Process I above 150 h (P3, exact-use goal)
#   d3II_plus: Process II time used above nominal capacity (P3, overtime)
#
# Objective (in words):
#   Lexicographic goal programming, encoded as a single weighted sum with
#   priority weights w1 >> w2 >> w3 so that higher-priority deviations are
#   driven to zero first.  Minimise the weighted sum of unwanted deviations:
#     P1: profit shortfall d1_minus
#     P2: contract shortfalls d2A_minus + d2B_minus
#     P3: Process I deviation (d3I_minus + d3I_plus) and Process II overtime
#         is to be MAXIMISED, so its deviation enters with a negative weight.
#
# Constraints (numbered, with source sentence):
#   (1) Profit goal (P1): 300*xA + 450*xB + d1_minus >= 10000
#   (2) Contract A (P2):  xA + d2A_minus >= 10
#   (3) Contract B (P2):  xB + d2B_minus >= 15
#   (4) Process I exact use (P3): 4*xA + 6*xB + d3I_minus - d3I_plus = 150
#   (5) Process II time (P3): 3*xA + 2*xB - d3II_plus <= 70
#       (nominal capacity 70; overtime allowed, so only over-use is tracked)
# =============================================================================

DATA = {
    # per-unit Process I hours
    "proc1_A": 4,
    "proc1_B": 6,
    # per-unit Process II hours
    "proc2_A": 3,
    "proc2_B": 2,
    # nominal capacities
    "cap_proc1": 150,
    "cap_proc2": 70,
    # profit per unit
    "profit_A": 300,
    "profit_B": 450,
    # profit goal
    "profit_goal": 10000,
    # contract minimums
    "min_A": 10,
    "min_B": 15,
    # priority weights (lexicographic surrogate: w1 >> w2 >> w3)
    "w1": 1_000_000,
    "w2": 1_000,
    "w3": 1,
    # weight for the maximised Process II overtime (negative => reward)
    "w3_II": -1,
    # big-M for the Process II overtime deviation upper bound
    "bigM_proc2": 100000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ---- Decision variables -------------------------------------------------
    model.xA = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.xB = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # ---- Deviation variables ------------------------------------------------
    model.d1_minus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.d2A_minus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.d2B_minus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.d3I_minus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.d3I_plus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.d3II_plus = pyo.Var(
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, d["bigM_proc2"])
    )

    # ---- Constraints --------------------------------------------------------
    # (1) Profit goal (P1)
    def profit_goal_rule(m):
        return (
            d["profit_A"] * m.xA
            + d["profit_B"] * m.xB
            + m.d1_minus
            >= d["profit_goal"]
        )

    model.profit_goal = pyo.Constraint(rule=profit_goal_rule)

    # (2) Contract minimum for model A (P2)
    def contract_A_rule(m):
        return m.xA + m.d2A_minus >= d["min_A"]

    model.contract_A = pyo.Constraint(rule=contract_A_rule)

    # (3) Contract minimum for model B (P2)
    def contract_B_rule(m):
        return m.xB + m.d2B_minus >= d["min_B"]

    model.contract_B = pyo.Constraint(rule=contract_B_rule)

    # (4) Process I exact-use goal (P3)
    def proc1_rule(m):
        return (
            d["proc1_A"] * m.xA
            + d["proc1_B"] * m.xB
            + m.d3I_minus
            - m.d3I_plus
            == d["cap_proc1"]
        )

    model.proc1_exact = pyo.Constraint(rule=proc1_rule)

    # (5) Process II time (P3): nominal capacity, overtime tracked
    def proc2_rule(m):
        return (
            d["proc2_A"] * m.xA
            + d["proc2_B"] * m.xB
            - m.d3II_plus
            <= d["cap_proc2"]
        )

    model.proc2_time = pyo.Constraint(rule=proc2_rule)

    # ---- Objective ----------------------------------------------------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        return (
            d["w1"] * m.d1_minus
            + d["w2"] * (m.d2A_minus + m.d2B_minus)
            + d["w3"] * (m.d3I_minus + m.d3I_plus)
            + d["w3_II"] * m.d3II_plus
        )

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model

    "proc_I_B": 6,            # "Process I (hours per unit) ... B = 6"

    # Goal p2 (contract)
    "min_A": 10,              # "at least 10 units of model A"
    "min_B": 15,              # "at least 15 units of model B"
    # Priority weights (p1 >> p2 >> p3) for the weighted goal-programming objective
    "w_profit": 1000000,      # highest priority p1
    "w_contract": 10000,      # second priority p2
    "w_proc_I": 100,          # third priority p3 (Process I exact time)
    "w_proc_II": 1,           # third priority p3 (maximise Process II time)
}

PRODUCTS = ["A", "B"]
PROCESSES = ["I", "II"]


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sets
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.PRODUCTS = pyo.Set(initialize=PRODUCTS)
    model.PROCESSES = pyo.Set(initialize=PROCESSES)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Decision variables : production quantities (units per week)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.PRODUCTS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Goal-programming deviation variables (all nonnegative)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # p1 : profit goal  -> penalise under-achievement
    model.under_profit = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # p2 : contract goals -> penalise under-achievement of min A and min B
    model.under_A = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.under_B = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # p3 : Process I exact-time goal -> penalise both over and under
    model.over_proc_I = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.under_proc_I = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # p3 : Process II actual time (overtime allowed; we maximise it)
    model.t_proc_II = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint : p1 profit goal  (>= 10000)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_profit_goal(m):
        return (d["profit_A"] * m.x["A"] + d["profit_B"] * m.x["B"]
                + m.under_profit == d["profit_goal"])
    model.profit_goal = pyo.Constraint(rule=rule_profit_goal)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraints : p2 contract goals (>= min_A, >= min_B)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_contract_A(m):
        return m.x["A"] + m.under_A == d["min_A"]
    model.contract_A = pyo.Constraint(rule=rule_contract_A)

    def rule_contract_B(m):
        return m.x["B"] + m.under_B == d["min_B"]
    model.contract_B = pyo.Constraint(rule=rule_contract_B)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint : p3 Process I time should be exactly 150 hours
    #   4*xA + 6*xB + under - over = 150
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_proc_I_goal(m):
        return (d["proc_I_A"] * m.x["A"] + d["proc_I_B"] * m.x["B"]
                + m.under_proc_I - m.over_proc_I == d["cap_I"])
    model.proc_I_goal = pyo.Constraint(rule=rule_proc_I_goal)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint : Process II time definition  t = 3*xA + 2*xB
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_proc_II_time(m):
        return (m.t_proc_II
                == d["proc_II_A"] * m.x["A"] + d["proc_II_B"] * m.x["B"])
    model.proc_II_time = pyo.Constraint(rule=rule_proc_II_time)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint : Process II must at least use its normal capacity (overtime
    #   beyond 70 is permitted, so this is a lower bound on t_proc_II)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_proc_II_capacity(m):
        return m.t_proc_II >= d["cap_II"]
    model.proc_II_capacity = pyo.Constraint(rule=rule_proc_II_capacity)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective : lexicographic goal programming via weighted sum
    #   minimise  w1*under_profit
    #           + w2*(under_A + under_B)
    #           + w3*(under_proc_I + over_proc_I) - w3'*t_proc_II
    #   (the negative term maximises Process II time at the lowest priority)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_obj(m):
        return (d["w_profit"] * m.under_profit
                + d["w_contract"] * (m.under_A + m.under_B)
                + d["w_proc_I"] * (m.under_proc_I + m.over_proc_I)
                - d["w_proc_II"] * m.t_proc_II)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=rule_obj, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    products = d["products"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel(name="Microcomputer_Goal_Programming")

    # --- Sets ---
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=products)

    # --- Variables ---
    # Decision: production quantity of each model (integer units)
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Deviations (goal programming), all nonnegative reals
    model.d_profit_minus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.d_contract_minus = pyo.Var(model.P, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.d_proc1_minus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)  # under 150 hrs
    model.d_proc1_plus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)   # over 150 hrs
    model.d_proc2_plus = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)   # Process II time used

    # --- Constraints ---

    # Profit goal: profit >= 10000, shortfall captured by d_profit_minus
    def profit_rule(m):
        total = sum(d["profit"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P)
        return total + m.d_profit_minus >= d["profit_goal"]
    model.con_profit = pyo.Constraint(rule=profit_rule)

    # Contractual minimums: A >= 10, B >= 15, shortfalls captured
    def contract_rule(m, p):
        target = d["min_A"] if p == "A" else d["min_B"]
        return m.x[p] + m.d_contract_minus[p] >= target
    model.con_contract = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=contract_rule)

    # Process I should be exactly 150 hours: 4A + 6B + d_minus - d_plus = 150
    def proc1_rule(m):
        used = sum(d["proc1_hours"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P)
        return used + m.d_proc1_minus - m.d_proc1_plus == d["cap_proc1"]
    model.con_proc1 = pyo.Constraint(rule=proc1_rule)

    # Process II time used = 3A + 2B, linked to d_proc2_plus (to be maximized)
    def proc2_rule(m):
        used = sum(d["proc2_hours"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P)
        return m.d_proc2_plus == used
    model.con_proc2 = pyo.Constraint(rule=proc2_rule)

    # --- Objective: minimize weighted, unwanted deviations ---
    # Highest priority: profit shortfall
    # Medium: contract shortfalls
    # Low: Process I deviation, and maximize Process II usage (so subtract d_proc2_plus)
    def obj_rule(m):
        return (
            d["w_profit"] * m.d_profit_minus
            + d["w_contract"] * sum(m.d_contract_minus[p] for p in m.P)
            + d["w_proc1"] * (m.d_proc1_minus + m.d_proc1_plus)
            - d["w_proc2_bonus"] * m.d_proc2_plus
        ) if "w_proc2_bonus" in d else (
            d["w_profit"] * m.d_profit_minus
            + d["w_contract"] * sum(m.d_contract_minus[p] for p in m.P)
            + d["w_proc1"] * (m.d_proc1_minus + m.d_proc1_plus)
            - m.d_proc2_plus
        )
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model

    # Big-M for Process II overtime and Process I bounds

}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets ---
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["pm"])

    # --- Variables ---
    m.x = pyo.Var(m.P, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Deviational variables for goal programming
    m.s1 = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)          # profit shortfall
    m.s2A = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)         # shortfall of A below 10
    m.s2B = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)         # shortfall of B below 15
    m.m3neg = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)       # Process I under-use (exact-150 goal)
    m.m3pos = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)       # Process I over-use
    m.o4 = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)          # Process II overtime / inefficiency

    # --- Priority 1: Profit goal (>= 10000), penalise shortfall ---
    def profit_target_rule(mm):
        return (
            sum(d["profit_unit"][p] * mm.x[p] for p in mm.P) + mm.s1
            >= d["profit_target"]
        )
    m.con_profit_target = pyo.Constraint(rule=profit_target_rule)

    # --- Priority 2a: at least 10 units of A ---
    def min_a_rule(mm):
        return mm.x["A"] + mm.s2A >= d["min_A"]
    m.con_min_A = pyo.Constraint(rule=min_a_rule)

    # --- Priority 2b: at least 15 units of B ---
    def min_b_rule(mm):
        return mm.x["B"] + mm.s2B >= d["min_B"]
    m.con_min_B = pyo.Constraint(rule=min_b_rule)

    # --- Priority 3a: Process I time exactly 150 ---
    def proc1_exact_rule(mm):
        return (
            sum(d["hours_I"][p] * mm.x[p] for p in mm.P) + mm.m3neg - mm.m3pos
            == d["cap_I"]
        )
    m.con_proc1_exact = pyo.Constraint(rule=proc1_exact_rule)

    # --- Priority 3b: Process II time can use overtime (linked by big-M) ---
    def proc2_capacity_rule(mm):
        return (
            sum(d["hours_II"][p] * mm.x[p] for p in mm.P) - d["cap_II"]
            <= mm.o4
        )
    m.con_proc2_capacity = pyo.Constraint(rule=proc2_capacity_rule)

    def proc2_overtime_bound_rule(mm):
        return mm.o4 <= d["bigM_II"]
    m.con_proc2_overtime_bound = pyo.Constraint(rule=proc2_overtime_bound_rule)

    # --- Objective: weighted preemptive goal program ---
    # p1: minimise profit shortfall s1
    # p2: minimise underachievement of A and B contract levels
    # p3a: minimise |Process I - 150|
    # p3b: minimise overtime of Process II
    def obj_rule(mm):
        return (
            d["w_profit"] * mm.s1
            + d["w_contract"] * (mm.s2A + mm.s2B)
            + d["w_processI"] * (mm.m3neg + mm.m3pos)
            + d["w_processII"] * mm.o4
        )
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return m

# =============================================================================
# GOAL PROGRAMMING MODEL (pre-emptive / lexicographic via weighted penalties)
# Microcomputers A and B, one-week planning horizon.
# =============================================================================
#
# DECISION VARIABLES
#   x[A], x[B] : units of model A / B produced per week (NonNegativeIntegers)
#   d1_minus   : under-achievement of profit goal (>= 0)
#   d2A_minus  : under-achievement of minimum A production (>= 0)
#   d2B_minus  : under-achievement of minimum B production (>= 0)
#   d3P1_minus : under-achievement of Process I target of 150 h (>= 0)

#   (4) Process I balance:  4 x_A + 6 x_B + d3P1_minus - d3P1_plus = 150
#   (5) Process II cap:     3 x_A + 2 x_B + d3P2_minus <= 70

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=(
            d["w1"] * m.d1_minus
            + d["w2"] * (m.d2A_minus + m.d2B_minus)
            + d["w3"] * (m.d3P1_minus + m.d3P1_plus + m.d3P2_minus)

        )
